sentences.text:
Writ Petition No.19910 of 2022
Order:
This Writ Petition is filed by the petitioner seeking following relief:
"....to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of
mandamus declaring the action of the Res

pondent Nos.2 to 4 in not taking any action on the petitioner representation dated 04.01.2021 seeking to restore his name in the revenue records for the land to an Acs.4-14  gts in Sy.No.147/aa out Acs. 6-24 gts situated at Rampuram village, Garla Mandal of Mahabubabad district by deleting the 5th respondent name and his name was shown in the land acquisition notification for the land to an extent of Acs.0-08 gts for the purpose of construction of railway 3rd lane though he does not have any title over the subject land

is as illegal and void and violation of Articles 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondent Nos. 2 to 4 to restore the petitioner's name in to revenue record for the land to an extent of Acs.4-14  gts in Sy.No.147/aa out Acs. 6-24 gts situated at Rampuram village, Garla Mandal of Mahabubabad district by deleting the 5th respondent name and further direct the respondent Nos. 2 to 4 not to pay the compensation to the 5th respondent..."

2. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties and perused the record.
3.

It is stated that the father of the petitioner is the owner and possessor of land admeasuring Acs.6-24 guntas in Survey No.147/aa situated at Rampuram village, Garla Mandal, Mahabubabad District and the revenue authorities have mutated the name of his father in all the revenue records and also issued pattadar passbooks in respect of the subject lands.

The case of the petitioner is that after the death of his father, the said land was partitioned and an extent of Ac.0-19 guntas has fell to his share and subsequently, the revenue authorities have issued e-pattadar passbooks in his favour.

The grievance of the petitioner is that the respondent authorities have mutated an extent of land admeasuring Acs.4-14 , in the name of respondent No.5, who is not having any right and title over the subject property, and in that regard, he submitted a representation, dated 04.01.2021 for deleting the name of respondent No.5 and to restore his name in the revenue records, but no action has been taken by the respondents till date.
4.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 4 submitted that except submitting the representation, dated 04.01.2021 before respondent No.2, the Jarpula Setram ,Seetharam vs The State Of Telangana And 4 Others on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190978109/

entities.text: Land and Pattadar Pass Books Act, 2020
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned Assistant Government Pleader further submitted that if the petitioner submits an online application through Darani Web Portal,
the respondent authorities would consider the same in accordance with law.

5. In view of the above submissions, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this writ petition directing the petitioner to submit an online application before the respondents for correction of the entries in the Dharani Portal and in the event of filing such application, the respondents are directed to consider the same and pass a reasoned order in accordance with law and communicate the decision thereon to the petitioner, within a period of three (3) months from the date of receipt of a copy of the application.
6. With the above observations this writ petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

__ C.V.BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 04.11.2024 sus Jarpula Setram ,Seetharam vs The State Of Telangana And 4 Others on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190978109/
